OCR request with a document URL input

```swift title="Swift"

let _request = try LiterLlm.ocrRequestFromJson("{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"https://example.com/doc.pdf\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}")
```
